intention: Make persist_validation the ONLY path that can write the validation trail — the door's append-only guarantee enforced by physics, not by everyone remembering to use the door.
why: A record of truth declared APPEND-ONLY by its door is a plain JSON file any caller can overwrite. The door enforces append-only and the ratified eight fields; NOTHING enforces that the door is used. A hand-write destroys a proof's whole seal history silently and permanently, and looks exactly like a fresh seal — Law 7's worst direction (silent, and in a record of truth). learned: THE PROOF KILLED THE FIRST DESIGN, on its first firing. The draft tolerated an unlinked leading PREFIX as 'prehistory', to carry the 73 trails that predated links — it read as the honest way to avoid redding the whole corpus on adoption day. The falsifier tooth showed it was the opposite: an overwrite that drops every link is indistinguishable from a legacy trail, and a total overwrite is exactly the destroy-the-whole-history shape this ticket's trouble described. THE GENERAL SHAPE, worth carrying past this ticket: A TOLERANCE IS A FORGER'S COSTUME WHENEVER THE FORGER CAN PRODUCE THE THING BEING TOLERATED. A compatibility clause is not neutral — it is a stated description of what the gate will wave through, and anything that can be shaped to match it walks. The fix was to remove the clause rather than narrow it: adopt the legacy trails once, and say plainly what a retro-minted link claims (content as of adoption, not as of sealing) instead of letting it wear a seal-time link's authority.
